modalities.evidence: MRI data of the human brain

output.population: 78 healthy adult volunteers (28 females, 50 males; age range: 20-53 years)
output.summary: Ultra-high field 9.4 T structural brain MRI from healthy adult volunteers, with manual gray/white matter segmentations of a subset validated by two neuroradiologists, provided in NIfTI format for neuroimaging method development.
